turns.text: Hey Lloyd, quick question. I was looking at AutoMem achieves 51% performance in benchmarks, doubling the performance of a Qwen 2.5 72B model. Is that standard for this year's papers?
That is indeed a very strong result. Doubling a 72B model is significant. Did you find the benchmark methodology robust?
Seems solid. Anyway, unrelated, did the coffee maker finally get fixed? I think I left it on.
I checked the smart home logs; it was turned off at 2 AM. You should be safe.
Phew. Thanks. I'll go grab the mail.
Lloyd, I'm reading more on AutoMem is a paper from Stanford that frames memory management as an active, trainable cognitive skill rather than passive storage. It's a nice conceptual shift.
Agreed. Treating memory as an active skill is a compelling direction for agentic systems.
It is. Hey, can you remind me to buy milk? I forgot it at the store.
I've added milk to your shopping list. Would you like me to set a reminder for tomorrow morning?
Yes, please. And thanks for the chat.
You're welcome. Have a great night.
